manifest_yaml:
name: install-acme-cli-3-1-4
needs:
  os: [linux]
  capabilities:
    - clean-home
    - pkg-install
    - network:*
  trust: first-party
  native: false
resources:
  cpu: 2
  memory: 2GB
  timeout: 300
steps:
  setup:
    - npm install --global acme-cli@3.1.4
  assert:
    - command -v acme
    - acme --version | grep -q '^3\.1\.4$'
report: install-diff

interpretation.first_failure: acme --version | grep -q '^3.1.4$' is the first failing command.
interpretation.escalation: One recorded transition: srt -> podman due to pkg-install denial.
interpretation.evidence_claim: Real Tier 1 Podman execution has a complete install diff, but the version assertion failed. Isolation was degraded because Microsandbox was unavailable, and network egress was unrestricted as declared.
